nodes.label: Muon-Catalysed Fusion: Definition, Procedure, and Two Gaps
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Draft v1.0, 1 August 2026, prepared under the protocols of The Method v1.2-8; supersedes the exploratory drafts v0.1-v0.14 of 'Cold Fusion Under a Closed Index'. The reframing is deliberate: on the stated definition cold fusion is neither speculative nor unachieved but routine since 1957, so the paper's job is to state the procedure and price the remaining gaps.

nodes.label: Cold fusion defined by molecular binding geometry, not temperature
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A fusion event whose approach to nuclear separation is supplied by molecular binding geometry rather than kinetic energy. Temperature does not appear — 'cold' is a consequence, and the name has misdirected the field for decades; the operative property is molecular access at nuclear separations.

nodes.label: Seven necessary conditions for a cold fusion reaction
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A binder, a molecular index with at least two bound states (so an edge cell exists), a formation channel reaching that edge cell, nuclear overlap, an open exit, binder release, and conservation closure. Conditions 1-5 suffice for the reaction to occur; 6-7 govern whether it is sustainable and verifiable.

nodes.label: The structural window [119, 918] electron masses
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Bounded below by fusion geometry (separation close enough that fusion outruns the cycle) and above by molecular-index survival (bound states scale as sqrt(M/m) and at least two are needed for an edge cell). The electron fails below, the tau above; muon and pion sit inside and the interaction-type filter removes the pion. The muon is interior by 1.74x and 4.44x, so the conclusion survives reasonable movement of either criterion.

nodes.label: The unique realisation: mu- + (d,t) -> 4He + n + mu- + 17.59 MeV
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Fully specified rather than schematic: the exit is fixed by nuclear structure because 5He is unbound, and the formation channel by a near-coincidence — the dtmu (J=1, v=1) state bound by 0.66 eV against the D2 vibrational quantum of 0.365 eV, so resonant transfer into host rovibrational excitation makes formation fast. Geometry is the mechanism (91 orders in tunnelling rate from mass substitution); screening is a correction to it (33 orders).

nodes.label: The binder factory: the accelerator as structure, not preamble
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The accelerator is the sole source of the one element the reaction cannot self-supply and the only element it destroys. Two decay lengths set the geometry — 11.2 m for a 200 MeV/c pion, 624 m for a 100 MeV/c muon — and the 56x ratio is what makes the machine possible. The kinematic floor is 0.30 GeV per muon against 5 GeV achieved, a 16.7x inefficiency that is not forbidden, which makes E_mu the most tractable free parameter. Flow, not batch: the muon decays regardless, so no steady state conserves binder inventory.

nodes.label: The energy gap: two sticking levers are required and neither suffices alone
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Cycles saturate at 1/omega_s once lambda_c is driven up, because driving the formation resonance moves the bottleneck to muon transfer at (2.7 +/- 0.9) x 10^8 /s, capping lambda_c near 2.6 x 10^8 /s. Breakeven needs omega_s <= 0.202-0.292% against 0.45-0.56% measured: dual polarisation alone (0.34%) fails at any density, while polarisation plus a J = 1 state mixture (0.234%) clears at phi >= 2.

nodes.label: The flux gap: 1 MW needs ~10^5 times the best planned muon source
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: 1 MW of fusion at 300 cycles per muon requires 1.2 x 10^15 mu/s against ~10^10 /s planned, so energy-positivity is necessary and not sufficient. The two gaps are independent and this is the harder: not a parameter to optimise but a machine that does not exist.

nodes.label: The ambient exclusion: enhanced electron screening fails by conservation
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Two independent grounds. Adiabaticity: at thermal energies the deuteron/electron velocity ratio is 1.0 x 10^-3, deeply adiabatic where static screening is exact, while beam measurements sit at 0.63 and squarely non-adiabatic, so a fitted screening parameter there absorbs stopping-power and straggling effects with no ambient counterpart. Energy audit: the complete site electronic inventory ceilings at ~30 eV against 88 eV required — a factor 2.9 in energy, 27 orders in rate. Conservation-grade, admitting no mitigation by vacuum, geometry, cooling or channel choice.
